blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence by restoring automatic combat causality, repairing arena spatial integrity around the preserved authored cemetery, and completing a clean ordinary title-to-result run with usable visual upgrade choices.

diagnosis.root_cause: The release candidate has two active integration defects: authoritative automatic lantern attacks complete while the Effects bus remains silent, and the shipped camera's occluder/sight-lane integration leaves the Warden and central landmarks only partially visible. The complete-run release surface also needs an end-to-end lifecycle and truthful build-choice presentation suitable for direct retest.

stop_conditions: Stop after the three bounded task families are implemented and expose their specified retest evidence to QA.
Do not expand into deferred dense-performance or ordinary-wave-route qualification unless a bounded repair reveals a new reproducible product defect.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause treatments for the repeated camera defect: repair the camera-to-authored-occluder binding and isolation/sight-lane behavior instead of repeating transform-only tuning. Repair combat through the product-owned attack/audio adapter and authoritative event chain, then finish the ordinary release lifecycle and choice presentation while preserving the authored map, weapon resources, and native Godot baselines.

code: Run static/import checks and native Godot boot validation; inspect touched scripts/scenes for parser errors and runtime error logs.
White-box verify attack event ownership, camera occluder bindings and collision anchors, upgrade transaction debounce, authoritative build mutation, and terminal/retry reset paths.
runtime: Capture one automatic lantern attack and one quick AUTO tap with fresh Effects/Master output, source-event timeline, and runtime state; verify one bounded report per attack, causal impact or miss, and stop-on-release/reset.

Replay spawn, critical route, and cardinal/landmark movement; capture camera coverage, spatial digest, collision/bounds, and same-framing screenshots proving larger traversable scale, external depth, central landmark visibility, no disappearance/occlusion drift, and perimeter containment.

Execute an ordinary run through wave progression, XP threshold, three-choice draft, death or victory, Result, and Retry; capture state receipts and screenshots for truthful statistics, choice visual hierarchy, focus states, clean reset, and complete-run presentation.
visual: Review shipped gameplay views at spawn, critical route, and landmark/cardinal positions for high-angle readability, visible Warden and central landmarks, coherent external world, grounded collision, and no proxy-floor or void presentation.
Review upgrade, pause, Result, and Retry screens for silhouette-led hierarchy, compact icons and deltas, restrained copy, full-viewport composition, and distinct keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

done_when: A single automatic lantern attack produces one bounded, recognizable onset/report and one causally matched impact or miss cue on the Effects bus; a quick AUTO tap does not duplicate the player report.
Attack, hit/miss, damage, death/drop, and recovery receipts remain tied to one authoritative attack id, and sustained audio stops on release, pause ownership change, retry, and terminal reset.
Tester can directly retest with a fresh mixed-output capture plus source-event timeline and runtime-log/state inspection.
tasks.instructions: Repair the product-owned lantern attack/report adapter and event routing so automatic targeting emits a short recognizable Effects-bus report with bounded onset, impact or miss, and recovery semantics. Inspect and repair the binding between WardenLanternRuntime, AttackRuntime, MournlightAudioDirector, and the scene-bound audio voices; do not replace preserved authored weapon resources or replay a complete shot through generic VFX. Keep enemy spatial cues separate and expose focused attack-source and lifecycle receipts for same-loop black-box and white-box retest.
tasks.title: Restore automatic lantern attack audio causality

done_when: The arena has an expand/larger traversable scale with coherent external world/external depth beyond the playable cemetery.

The central building/landmark package, keeper post, mausoleum, and cracked bell remain stably readable from spawn, critical route, and cardinal views during ordinary movement/movement replay; no disappearance or occlusion drift hides the Warden or threats.

Collision agrees with authored streets and structures; the player cannot pass through the central building, cross the intended boundary/perimeter, or encounter a proxy floor that masks the native map.

Tester can replay the same movement route and inspect runtime spatial digest, camera coverage, collision/bounds, and screenshots for landmark visibility, collision, disappearance/occlusion, and boundary containment.
tasks.instructions: Repair the camera/world integration around the preserved authored cemetery as one authoritative environment instance. Use direct occluder-binding and visibility-isolation repair (including camera-aware transparency or authored sight lanes where needed), not another transform-only tuning pass. Reconcile ArenaCamera coverage bindings with the native mausoleum, trees, keeper post, and cracked bell; keep external world/external depth, native streets, collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and the playable boundary/perimeter coherent. Remove or minimize unrelated proxy/support geometry that causes disappearance or occlusion during ordinary movement/movement replay without replacing or surgically modifying the authored package.
tasks.title: Repair arena occluder isolation, scale, collision, and landmark visibility

done_when: A complete ordinary run supports the title Play entry, automatic combat, five escalating waves including the Bellkeeper boss, level-up pauses, victory or failure, and a seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result lifecycle without stale state.

The Result screen truthfully shows time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt, damage taken, selected upgrades, outcome, credits/provenance, and replay/title actions; Retry starts a clean fresh run after repeated restarts.

Each level-up choice leads with a recognizable weapon/upgrade silhouette, uses compact stat icons, shows truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omits unchanged or placeholder CURRENT values, and exposes distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.

The implementation preserves distinct viable focused-bolts, close-range-sweeps, and orbiting-area-control build shapes across successful ordinary runs; clocks pause during the draft and selected upgrades mutate authoritative build state before resume.
Tester can directly replay lifecycle branches and inspect runtime state, screenshots, and logs for clean Result/Retry reset and choice hierarchy.
tasks.instructions: Complete the ordinary release lifecycle as one authoritative state machine spanning title, gameplay, wave/director progression, XP and upgrade transactions, pause, death or victory, Result, Retry, and return to title. Repair the HUD and upgrade draft presentation so the required authored visual hierarchy, truthful compact deltas, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states are visible at the shipped viewport and remain readable over the pause backdrop. Keep five waves, Bellkeeper victory/failure outcomes, statistics, credits/provenance, and clean repeated replay behavior coherent; add only focused receipts needed for direct QA retest.
tasks.title: Complete ordinary run, visual choices, and Result/Retry release flow
